instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\dual_pocket_bracket.step. Create a multi-operation milling program. Rough and finish both top pockets with 2D Pocket operations, then finish the outside profile using 2D Contour. Pocket floors must be Z=6.000 mm and the outside contour must machine down to Z=0.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm flat end mill for pocket roughing; T2 is a 6 mm flat end mill for pocket finishing and outer contour finishing. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-7.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
source: 2D Pocket、2D Contour、NC Program 文档。(Autodesk Help) https://help.autodesk.com/view/fusion360/ENU/?contextId=MFG-REF-NC-OLD-V-NEW&utm_source=chatgpt.com
